sections.regime_assumption_check: With `history_run_count` 26, only `regime_summary.windows[full_sample]` is active (9 `exclusion_week_pairs`; rolling 8/16/24 slices wait on phase `regime_slices_8_16_24`). Exclusion archive quality still looks modestly supportive: `cumulative_exclusion_alpha` **+0.00261**, `positive_alpha_rate` **0.5556**, `bottom_quartile_exclude_rate` **0.1276**, `top_quartile_retain_rate` **0.8794**, with `recommended_exclusion_step` **u3** — but **u4** on the same ladder is only **+0.000508** (`exclusion_universe.ladder_results_slim`), so tightening toward the live shadow step is not clearly superior on archive alpha alone. Primary-track cohort quality does **not** hold: `primary_excess_after_costs` **-0.1742**, `beat_market` / `beat_control` false, and `regime_summary.flags` includes **`primary_underperforming_market`**. Trajectory evidence prioritizes **opinion-flip weakness** over static fit: `trajectory_evidence.prediction_hit_rate_by_horizon` is **0.406** at **1w** (266 scored) vs **0.519** at **4w** (158 scored), **8w** **0.3889** (n=18), **12w** unscored; `weeks_to_realization` shows **median_weeks** **1**, **within_4w_rate** **0.9448**, **realized_within_12w_rate** **0.5993** — consistent with `realization_lag` (fast price realization, weak 1w directional sign). `hold→buy` and `buy→strong_buy` 1w flips show **positive_rate 0.25** with negative mean forward returns; `upgrade_events` mean **-0.003031** vs `downgrade_events` **+0.006744**, i.e. upgrades underperform downgrades on short horizons — a decay/reversal pattern in the assessment model, not in exclusion alpha alone.

Execute `convergence_summary.look_now`: observe **ai_judgment_exclusion_u4** forward vs live primary, do not auto-apply calibration priors under these tensions, and count **≥4** consecutive weeks of shadow differentiation toward `filtered_cohort_track`. `trajectory_evidence.model_focus_candidates` imply an **assessment-model gap** (conviction/timing lag and weak **hold→buy** / **1w** direction), not a universe-size gap. `hypothesis_integrity.tracks.ai_judgment_fair`: **within_tolerance** **true**, one **intact_loser**, **selection_feedback_flags** **[]** — prefer thesis review over crude stops.
